interface.title: Binary Classification Workbench
interface.field: Applied machine learning for tabular data: astrophysics (classifying HI 21-cm absorbers as associated or intervening) and rare-event fraud/AML detection
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and modelling: exploring the data, fitting and evaluating classifiers, choosing a decision threshold and scoring new observations
interface.what_it_is_for: Fit a binary classifier on a stratified train/test split, with a choice of model and class-imbalance method, then judge it by precision, recall, F1, PR/ROC curves and a decision threshold you can tune, before scoring an unlabelled CSV with the fitted model.

data.note: I used the three built-in datasets: Curran (2021), 136 HI absorbers (80 associated, 56 intervening); Mondal et al. (2025), 118 absorbers; and a synthetic fraud set of 25,000 accounts with a 1.5% positive rate. For Predict New Data I uploaded the test file curran_2021_unlabelled_predict.csv (10 rows, one missing ZERO-TO-ZERO value) and downloaded the scored file, binary_classification_predictions.csv. I read the whole downloaded file: it holds 10 rows with 'Predicted positive probability' and 'Predicted class' columns, and the row with the missing ZERO-TO-ZERO value was scored (probability 0.486, Intervening at 0.50). I did not try the 'Use your own data' options with a file or URL of my own.

tree.general: Build, evaluate and apply a binary classifier for a rare or imbalanced outcome, choosing the decision rule on purpose rather than by accuracy
tree.specific: Classify HI absorbers as associated or intervening (and fraud accounts as suspect), compare models and imbalance methods, tune the threshold, and score unlabelled absorbers

screens_never_reached: A dataset loaded through 'Use your own data' (Upload your own CSV, or Remote CSV URL). I opened both inputs (screens/059.webp, screens/060.webp) but had no labelled CSV and could not use a URL outside 127.0.0.1, so the configuration screen for a user dataset (choosing the target column) never appeared.
Predict New Data scoring for the fraud and Mondal datasets: the only test file matches the Curran schema.
not_done: 'Download empty input template' (inside Required predictor columns): the button timed out because the expander collapsed when the page redrew, so no template file was downloaded.
I did not change the Test fraction slider, so I never saw a split other than 0.2.
I did not check whether an operating point holds up under a different seed or test fraction; the seed changed only once (42 → 43 in t8), together with the model, so it is not a robustness check.
I did not try every classifier × imbalance-method combination; I tried four combinations across the datasets.
The Interpretation tab was viewed only for the Curran XGBoost model.
Run model often needed two presses after another control changed: the first press only re-rendered the page with the stale-model notice (screens/037.webp, 040.jpg, 046.jpg, 057.jpg).

The threshold sliders sometimes kept an earlier value. After refitting XGBoost on the fraud data, Threshold Tuning's Inspect threshold stayed at 0.13 from the previous Decision Tree fit, even though the maximum-F1 threshold was reported as 0.62 (screens/051.webp); after dragging to 0.62 the chart's red Selected threshold line still sat near 0.13 (screens/053.webp). In Predict New Data the slider started at 0.12 while the caption called 0.50 'the current default' (screens/026.webp).
